verdict.rationale: AngelList's own docs describe one real bulk capability: administrators can e-sign an unlimited number of documents at once. Equity Blocks, where boards pre-approve standard grants, also reduces per-item work. There is no evidence of bulk operations beyond signing, and the OpenAPI probe found nothing, so there is no programmatic path for AI-native bulk actions. Missing for 10: bulk editing, importing or updating of stakeholders and securities, bulk issuance or termination actions, an API or programmatic bulk interface, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once

citations.quote: AngelList solves this problem with bulk e-sign, which enables administrators to sign an unlimited number of documents at once.
Boards approve AngelList Equity Blocks in advance so standard grants no longer require individual board approvals.
